statements.statement: Absent service reductions, an override is likely required for FY27.
Health insurance, retirement assessment, and school transportation are major cost drivers exceeding revenue growth.
Free cash has not been certified, which directly affects planning for town meeting funding of the capital plan, reserve transfers, and the snow and ice deficit.
The school committee had discussed the school budget using certain healthcare figures that turned out to be lower, requiring the budget to be adjusted.

warnings.prediction: Many capital plan projects will go unfunded, with two large projects (a road bridge and the public safety roof) consuming much of the available funding.
A high year-end deficit is expected given the number of snow events so far.

warnings.about: the FY25 closeout and its effect on FY27 planning
warnings.condition: if the books are not reconciled and Schedule A submitted
warnings.prediction: If the FY25 closeout is not resolved, the town faces a slippery slope: local aid withheld, and knock-on effects on the capital plan and funding the snow and ice deficit.

warnings.condition: if the town proceeds with winding down remaining TCP operations
warnings.prediction: Some user groups of the TC Pacios building will see substantial impact to their operations.
